Chief of Naval Operations · 1974–1978 · at the fall, 1975-04-30

CNO on the fall date. Task Force 76 off Vung Tau took the helicopters and the refugees; sailors pushed Hueys over the side to make deck room.

The office

The Joint Staff, the Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia. The Chairman’s office is on the E-ring, second floor, river side; the Chiefs meet in the “Tank”, Room 2E924, and from 1972 in the Gold Room next to it.
